description: This file is a Java Spring Boot REST controller named NoteController, responsible for exposing CRUD API endpoints for managing notes within a note-taking application. It handles operations such as listing all notes, retrieving a specific note by ID, creating, updating, and deleting notes, along with validation and exception handling.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: A REST controller managing CRUD operations for notes, with endpoints to list, retrieve, create, update, and delete notes, including validation and exception handling.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes, sorted by their ID.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its ID, returning 404 if not found.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note based on the provided request body.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new data; handles not found errors.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, returning the appropriate response or error if not found.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation exceptions, returning detailed errors for invalid input.
